effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may trash 3 cards from the top of your deck. Then, for every 10 cards in your trash, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] For every 10 cards in your trash, gain 1 memory.
